* The Chinese title of this Exclusive Channel is taken from the first verse of the poem {{zh|代白頭吟|Dài Báitóu Yín}} by writer {{w|Bao Zhao}}, who lived during the Northern and Southern Dynasties period. '''An Outstanding Partner''' is the permanent [[Combat Bangboo]] [[Signal Search]] with no time limit. 

==Rules==
* '''A-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any A-Rank (or above) signal within 9 signal searches in a row, the 10th signal is ''guaranteed'' to be an A-Rank (or higher) signal. <!--(On guarantee, the probability of getting an A-Rank item is 99.4%, and the probability of getting an S-Rank item is 0.6%.)-->
* '''S-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any S-Rank signal after 79 signal searches, the 80th signal search is ''guaranteed'' to be an S-Rank signal. <!--(''On average'', a greater proportion of S-Rank items are dropped between 74 and 90 pity.)-->
** This counter will reset if the player obtains any S-Rank signal.
** Bangboo Channel does not contain S-Rank W-Engines or Agents in their item pool, as such each S-Rank signal will be a Combat Bangboo.
* '''Selected S-Rank Bangboo guarantee:''' Before signal searching on the Bangboo Channel, players need to select one S-Rank Bangboo. Every time a player obtains an S-Rank signal, it is guaranteed to be the previously selected S-Rank Bangboo. 
* '''Counter and Guarantee carry-over:''' Once an S-Rank Bangboo is selected, players can switch targets to a different S-Rank Bangboo without resetting the number of signal searches, thus retaining the guarantee.

'''Untainted Jade''' is a [[Exclusive Channel]] with {{Intro/Agent/Full|Qingyi}} as the promoted Agent with an increased chance to be obtained.

==History==
{{Signal Search History Table}}

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* The Chinese title of this Exclusive Channel is taken from the second verse of the poem {{zh|代白頭吟|Dài Báitóu Yín}} by writer {{w|Bao Zhao}}, who lived during the Northern and Southern Dynasties period. This verse in particular prescribes that a person of ideals and integrity must be as unsullied and uncorrupted as the ice that forms inside a jade jug. The verse is actually {{zh|{{Color|new|清}}如玉壺冰|qīng rú yù hú bīng}}, but ''Zenless Zone Zero'' has adapted it to use Qingyi's {{zh|青|Qīng}} as the first character instead, playing on the homophony of the two words. Moreover, the choice of the title reflects Qingyi's tie to jade, since has several jade objects, from her hair decorations to the tea set she uses in her [[:File:Dynamic Wallpaper Qingyi.mp4|Dynamic Wallpaper]], and her W-Engine [[Ice-Jade Teapot]], which is a reference to this verse, too.
** This title is thus parallel to [[Zhu Yuan]]'s Exclusive Channel [[Unswerving Bullet]], with which it completes the poem's first couplet {{zh|直如朱絲繩，清如玉壺冰|zhí rú zhū sī shéng, qīng rú yù hú bīng}}.

'''Exclusive Rescreening''' is a [[Signal Search]] channel that features three promotional S-Rank [[Agent]]s. All the promotional S-Rank Agents will have an increased probability for players to signal search for them when compared to the basic rates when the guarantees are factored in.

==Signal Search Details==
* The first S-Rank Signal obtained from the Exclusive Rescreening channel is guaranteed to be the currently selected limited S-Rank Agent (this guarantee mechanism is referred to below as the "Special Guarantee"). Every period's channels will have three different limited S-Rank Agents available for selection. Proxies can switch tabs on the Signal Search page at any time to change the featured Agent.
* During each Exclusive Rescreening period, the first 10-Signal Searches will be 20% off, consuming only {{Item|Encrypted Master Tape|x=8}}. From the 2nd 10-Signal Searches onwards, the number of Encrypted Master Tapes required will return to the original amount.
* The Search count for guaranteed Signals is cumulative across all Exclusive Rescreening channels but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Channels.

==Special Notes==
* The 20% discount on the first 10-Signal Searches applies to all channels in the current Exclusive Rescreening and can only be applied once during the current period. Changing the rate-up Agent will not reset the discount.
* The 20% discount on the first 10-Signal Searches resets with each Exclusive Rescreening update, and unused discounts will not carry over to the next period.
* This Special Guarantee applies to all channels in the current Exclusive Rescreening and can only trigger once during the current period. Changing the rate-up Agent will not reset the Special Guarantee.
* This guarantee resets with each Exclusive Rescreening update, and untriggered guarantee counts will not carry over to the next period.
* The Special Guarantee and standard guarantee counts are tracked separately and do not affect each other: When a Proxy obtains an S-Rank Agent for the first time during the current Exclusive Rescreening channel, the Special Guarantee will be triggered first. After the Special Guarantee is triggered, subsequent S-Rank Agent signals will follow the standard guarantee rules, and the standard guarantee count will continue to accumulate throughout that channel.

'''W-Engine Reverberation''' is a [[Signal Search]] channel that features three promotional S-Rank [[W-Engine]]s. All the promotional S-Rank W-Engines will have an increased probability for players to signal search for them when compared to the basic rates when the guarantees are factored in.

==Signal Search Details==
* The first S-Rank Signal obtained from the W-Engine Reverberation is guaranteed to be the currently selected limited S-Rank W-Engine (this guarantee mechanism is referred to below as the "Special Guarantee"). Every period's channels will have three different limited S-Rank W-Engines available for selection. Proxies can switch tabs on the Signal Search page at any time to change the featured W-Engine.
* During each W-Engine Reverberation period, the first 10-Signal Searches will be 20% off, consuming only {{Item|Encrypted Master Tape|x=8}}. From the 2nd 10-Signal Searches onwards, the number of Encrypted Master Tapes required will return to the original amount.
* The Search count for guaranteed Signals is cumulative across all W-Engine Reverberation channels but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Channels.

==Special Notes==
* The 20% discount on the first 10-Signal Searches applies to all channels in the current W-Engine Reverberation and can only be applied once during the current period. Changing the rate-up W-Engine will not reset the discount.
* The 20% discount on the first 10-Signal Searches resets with each W-Engine Reverberation update, and unused discounts will not carry over to the next period.
* This Special Guarantee applies to all channels in the current W-Engine Reverberation and can only trigger once during the current period. Changing the rate-up W-Engine will not reset the Special Guarantee.
* This guarantee resets with each W-Engine Reverberation update, and untriggered guarantee counts will not carry over to the next period.
* The Special Guarantee and standard guarantee counts are tracked separately and do not affect each other: When a Proxy obtains an S-Rank W-Engine for the first time during the current W-Engine Reverberation channel, the Special Guarantee will be triggered first. After the Special Guarantee is triggered, subsequent S-Rank W-Engine signals will follow the standard guarantee rules, and the standard guarantee count will continue to accumulate throughout that channel.
